status: provisional development specification; not a final benchmark freeze

adjacency.definition: undirected native cell edges counted once; both class-presence conditions also required

parameter_rationale.presence: 5% of full patch area avoids treating isolated mapped pixels as presence; illustrative development choice, not validated on ten patches or borrowed from original presence generation
parameter_rationale.boundary: 60 m = six 10-m edges; positive finite contact requirement rather than a corner touch; provisional, not established optimal
parameter_rationale.freeze: larger development coverage and reference plausibility checks required before final selection

original_txt_adjacency.finding: Section 3.1 mentions pairwise adjacency but does not specify four-neighbor contact or a 60-m threshold; this is our derived rule.
